CustomField.description: Used in Conga to put the Shipping Address on the Quote, since Conga only pulls in the Contact Point Address Name, and not the actual Address
CustomField.formula: Shipping_Address__r.Street & br() & Shipping_Address__r.City & IF(ISBLANK(Shipping_Address__c), NULL, ", ") & Shipping_Address__r.State & " " & Shipping_Address__r.PostalCode
CustomField.label: Selected Shipping Address
